svg.text: Representative epoch: obstructive cluster with a post-arousal central pause
5-year-old with adenotonsillar hypertrophy. AHI 14.2/h, OAHI 12.9/h, CAI 1.3/h, SpO₂ nadir 84%
Obstructive: no airflow, effort continues (often paradoxical)
Central: no airflow and no effort
Schematic 60-second epoch matched to this case's data; not a real patient recording.
